Package org.ujorm.orm.utils

Class StatementCache<V>

java.lang.Object
org.ujorm.orm.utils.StatementCache<V>
Type Parameters:
V - Type of the primary key
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class StatementCache<V> extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Handles caching, execution and resource cleanup of batched statements.
